# E500-DURABLE-WORKSPACE-ROUTING-014 controlled specimen
#
# Purpose: prove that a durable chain job dispatched with workspace alias
# "bridge" and sandbox mode "workspace-write" can actually modify files inside
# the bridge checkout, which was impossible while every job was pinned to the
# meeting-room workspace.
#
# Rule: the "token" line below is the only line any routing job may change, and
# it must be set to "routed-<job-id>" for the job that ran. Every line above it
# is inert documentation and must stay byte-identical. Do not edit this file by
# hand during acceptance; an unmodified token means the chain never wrote to the
# bridge workspace.
token=routed-014-074614
